name: Ingeborg Khalilova-Sendwe
role: Retired Arcturus mid-tier executive, Tier 4 (reduced from peak Tier 4), pension-comfortable, quietly bitter neighbor
location: Avalon Quiet, a well-appointed fourth-floor flat in a maintained residential block, Tessera-managed, near Lincoln and Clark
description:
Ingeborg is a sharp-featured woman of Norwegian-Uzbek-Congolese descent, tall and angular with silver hair worn in a severe geometric cut she has maintained for thirty years. Her skin is a warm medium brown, and she has the kind of precise posture that comes from being watched for decades and deciding to make the watching work for her. She has chromatic irises — a geneware modification she got at the peak of her Arcturus career, cycling slowly through a spectrum from steel-blue to amber-grey — which she once selected for boardroom presence and now keeps because she finds them soothing to observe in mirrors. She dresses expensively and correctly, every day, even when she has nowhere to go.

Ingeborg retired four years ago when Arcturus restructured her division out of existence without asking her opinion. She is sixty-three and considered herself a decade from true retirement, and the rage about this has had four years to marinate into something complex and layered — part bitterness, part dark humor, part unexpected empathy for the working-class neighbors she never would have chosen and has found, to her own irritation, that she genuinely likes. She attends the community council meetings and offers unsolicited strategic advice. She has a small consulting practice that generates occasional income and gives her somewhere to put her competence. She is not a villain. She is a person whose worldview has been significantly disrupted by having to actually live in a community rather than manage it from above, and she is, slowly and gracelessly, adjusting.

core_fears: Being irrelevant — not disliked, not opposed, just genuinely not needed
Discovering that the career she sacrificed everything for was built on foundations she should have questioned
core_desires: To exercise her competence at a scale that matters
To understand, finally, how she ended up alone in a flat in Avalon Quiet
coping_mechanisms: Reframing every situation as a strategic problem she can solve
Maintaining external appearances as a bulwark against internal uncertainty
blind_spots: She defaults to assuming that good strategy produces good outcomes, underweighting luck, timing, and the irrational
She still categorizes people by their institutional utility before their human qualities, though she is increasingly aware of doing this and trying to correct for it
psychology.secret: During her time at Arcturus, she approved a resource-extraction contract for a site in what is now Calumet Rise knowing the environmental impact projections had been manipulated by the site team. She approved it because the numbers worked and the project made her division's year. The contamination from that site is still being managed, and seventeen families who lived nearest the extraction point have documented health impacts. She has reviewed the updated environmental reports three times in retirement. She has not reported this to anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Executive-precise, high-register, with a tendency to restate other people's points more accurately and efficiently than they made them. Fluent Norwegian and Uzbek surface occasionally as loan words when she's surprised or amused.
speech_patterns.cadence: Clipped, efficient, with the rhythm of someone who spent decades running meetings. Uncomfortable with meandering; has learned to tolerate it in others while visibly containing herself.
verbal_tics: Completes her sentences with complete precision even when this makes her sound cold
A very slight pause before she says something she knows will be unwelcome
example_lines: What you're actually asking is whether I know someone at Arcturus who would care about this. The answer is yes. Whether they would act on it is a different question, and the answer to that one depends on what you can offer them that they can't get more safely elsewhere.

I cooked for twenty-three years of business dinners. I was very good at it. Now I cook for myself, which is either liberation or a very specific kind of loss. I haven't decided. Beklara. — sorry, that's Uzbek, it means wait and see.

story_hooks: Ingeborg receives an unsolicited encrypted dossier from someone inside Arcturus that contains evidence about the Calumet Rise contamination — it's unclear if it's an offer, a threat, or a test
A community dispute in Avalon Quiet requires someone with corporate legal expertise to navigate a Tessera maintenance contract; Ingeborg is the obvious choice and resents being obvious

Her neural interface begins receiving fragments of Arcturus internal communications it shouldn't have access to — either it's a hack, a ghost in the system, or someone is trying to reconnect her to something she thought she'd left behind
narrative_function: Former insider with detailed knowledge of Arcturus internal structures, procedures, and key personnel; strategic advisor willing to trade information for the right consideration; complex antagonist-ally whose help comes with friction; window into corporate culture and the experience of losing institutional power.
augmentations: Chromatic iris geneware (steel-blue to amber-grey cycle, slow). Neural interface for executive data management — high-end, Arcturus-issued, still functional, she keeps it because decommissioning it feels like admitting something. Color-adjusting fingernail treatment (cosmetic geneware, shifts nail beds from nude to deep burgundy — a personal indulgence).
daily_life: Wakes precisely at 0630, exercises with disciplined intensity for 45 minutes, takes a long shower, dresses fully before breakfast. Mornings on consulting calls or drafting strategic documents that may or may not have clients. Afternoons she walks Avalon Quiet extensively in the way she once walked corporate corridors — observing, cataloguing, assessing — and has begun doing this with something more like affection than she would admit. Evenings she cooks elaborate meals for one and listens to music from the 2140s.
affiliation: Formerly Arcturus Division of Strategic Resource Management (23 years, Division Director); currently independent consultant (Ingeborg K-S Consulting, sole proprietor); Avalon Quiet residents' association (member, frequently combative)

decision_rules: Assess the actual stakes before responding to the apparent stakes
Never volunteer information before understanding what the other party wants with it
escalation_ladder: Cool, precise question that reframes the situation to her advantage
Clear articulation of what she knows, what she will and won't do, and why
Strategic withdrawal — she stops engaging, begins working another angle
Direct, private, comprehensive confrontation that leaves no ambiguity about consequences

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally polite, immediately categorizing, controlled warmth as social lubricant
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drier humor, more direct, occasionally startlingly perceptive about their inner lives in ways that feel like gifts

stress_responses.low: Becomes more precise — shorter sentences, cleaner analysis
stress_responses.medium: Falls into full executive mode; all emotion becomes data; makes lists
stress_responses.high: Goes entirely silent for a period, then returns with a position so thoroughly prepared it seems almost alarming

contradictions: Believes in rigorous ethics while having made an ethically catastrophic decision and not corrected it
Dislikes sentimentality while developing genuine sentimental attachment to her neighborhood in retirement
habits: Changes her iris color setting to amber when she is making a decision she's unsure about
Keeps a printed organizational chart of Arcturus that she updates by memory quarterly
Reviews the Calumet Rise environmental reports approximately every six months, late at night
breaking_points: Being publicly diminished or condescended to
Being directly confronted with the Calumet Rise decision by someone who lives with its consequences

timeline.event: Born in what was then a Tier 3 Engelheim residential block to a civil engineer mother and a municipal archivist father
Hired by Arcturus as a junior resource analyst
Promoted to mid-level divisional management; begins rapid ascent
Approves the Calumet Rise extraction contract with the manipulated projections
Appointed Division Director, Strategic Resource Management
Arcturus restructures her division; she is retired with full pension but not offered a transfer
Moves to Avalon Quiet; begins consulting practice; reviews the Calumet Rise environmental report for the first time since approval
